This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Mando9" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|yellow]] skin.<ref name="Mando9" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate}}</ref> a member of this species was present at [[Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk]] when [[Gor Koresh|Koresh]] attempted to take [[Din Djarin]]'s [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin's armor|armor]].<ref name="Mando9" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|first episode]] of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Jon Favreau]].<ref name="Mando9" />
